backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no implemented methods.
feature_evidence.json: Structured report listing implemented features, related files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file mapping frontend source paths to short functional descriptions of each component or module.
frontend/.env.example: Example environment file defining the VITE_WEBHOOK_URL variable used for ActivePieces webhooks.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Guide explaining how to create build drafts, run deployments, verify functionality, and troubleshoot issues.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS file defining OKLCH color tokens, dark mode variables, and base styles.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Determines whether to show SignInPage or DashboardPage based on Internet Identity auth state.
frontend/src/components/AskAI/AskAIModul: Ask AI interface allowing users to submit questions, view answers, handle errors, and manage webhook help.
frontend/src/components/FileUpload.tsx: Drag‑and‑drop file upload component with preview, upload triggering, and clear functionality.
Defines the main application layout with header, footer, and sign-out button. Wraps all page content inside a consistent shell.
frontend/src/components/Quiz/Interactive: Renders an interactive quiz where users select answers and receive immediate correct/incorrect feedback. Manages per-question state and disables options after answering.
frontend/src/components/Quiz/QuizSection: Wraps the quiz in a card with controls to hide/show the quiz and delete it. Displays InteractiveQuiz when visible.
frontend/src/components/SummaryCard.tsx: Shows a summary inside a card with optional delete action or a placeholder when no summary exists. Renders formatted text content.
frontend/src/components/WebhookSetupHelp: Provides UI to view, save, or clear a webhook URL with validation and success/error states. Uses stored overrides and notifies parent callbacks.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the user's identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes. Uses React Query for lifecycle management.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication state and helpers, loading stored identities and managing login/logout flow. Exposes context to the app via a provider and hook.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind layers and CSS variables for light/dark themes. Applies base styling and color system tokens.
frontend/src/lib/activepieces.ts: Sends notes and questions to a webhook endpoint to generate summaries, quizzes, or AI answers with strict response validation. Implements uploadFile and askAI API helpers.
frontend/src/lib/env.ts: Resolves a single webhook URL from a runtime override or VITE_WEBHOOK_URL and throws an error if missing.
frontend/src/lib/types.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for quiz items and backend responses for uploads and Ask AI.
frontend/src/lib/webhookOverride.ts: Manages webhook URL overrides in localStorage with validation, save, retrieve, and clear helpers.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app root with React Query and Internet Identity provider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard UI handling file uploads, error display, webhook setup help, and showing summary and quiz results.
frontend/src/pages/SignInPage.tsx: Renders Internet Identity sign-in UI with loading and error handling.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins.
frontend/WEBHOOK_SETUP.md: Documentation describing how to configure the ActivePieces webhook URL for processing notes and AI queries.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, architectural notes, known issues, and existing feature definitions.
